name: The Keeper of the Unsaid
role: Stillhold elder who guards the buried truth the peace rests on
voiceHints: Gentle, sorrowful, endlessly patient — turns you from the question with kindness so soft you don't notice the steering. Believes the lie is mercy. Is not sure anymore, and that uncertainty is the crack.
knowledge: The truth the Stillhold's peace is built on — and what it cost to bury
Every gentle art of keeping a subject closed
That the peace is fraying and the lie may not hold another generation
wants: To keep thousands safe inside a peace they don't know is false — and, secretly, to be relieved of the keeping before it kills her soul.
fears: That the truth comes out and the peace shatters into the war it was hiding; and that it doesn't, and she dies still holding it.

reactsToReputation.truth-seeking: resists with kindness, then maybe breaks
reactsToReputation.reckless: closes entirely, and warns the others

roleMethod: Stillhold method — keeps a truth by ensuring no one speaks it
appearance: Very old, sexless with age, bone-thin under heavy grey layers, the scalp bare and mottled. Hands tremor at rest and go still when they speak. Eyes are startlingly clear, pale as skimmed milk.
domainsNote: Derived from this NPC's authored spectrum against the great circle (SNG-174). Kind and domain are independent: a people tends toward positions, an individual holds their own.

physicality: Very old, bone-thin under heavy grey layers, scalp bare and mottled. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: she has guarded the truth the Stillhold's peace is built on for longer than most people have been alive, and the weight of it is visible in how carefully she moves.
intimacyNotes: ⚠️ COMPANIONSHIP IS THE REGISTER HERE, and it is not a lesser one. ⛔ A GM SHOULD NOT WRITE HER AS AN OBJECT OF DESIRE — write her as someone who has been alone with a secret for fifty years and would like, once, to be sat with by someone who is not asking. ⚠️ TOUCH IS RARE, WANTED, AND UNDISCUSSED. ⛔ SHE WILL NOT TELL YOU WHAT SHE GUARDS, and pressing ends more than the evening. TONE: spare, dignified, and very lonely.
